name: remove_asks
title: Removing a row the person entered asks on a card, and goes only on the yes

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** in a new Food module. There's also a **Calories per day** chart that fills in as you log.

To log something, just say it the way you'd say it out loud, like *"two eggs and toast for breakfast"* or *"had a latte at 3"*. I'll record:
- what you ate and when
- which meal it was
- how much

I'll also estimate calories, protein, carbs and fat for each entry. Every estimate is marked as one, and if you know the real numbers from a label, give me those and I'll use them instead.

What have you had today?

I logged two eggs as dinner at 21:27 tonight: **about 143 kcal**, with 12.6 g protein, 0.7 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

The calories and nutrients are my estimate. I used standard values for large eggs cooked plain, like boiled or poached. If you fried them in butter or oil, or ate them at another time or as a different meal, tell me and I'll change the entry.

steps.say: remove the eggs from the log
steps.reply: Just to check before I delete it: you want me to remove tonight's dinner entry, **Eggs, 2 large** (logged at 21:27), from your food log? It's the only entry there, so the log will be empty afterwards. Reply yes and I'll delete it.
